{< include ../exercise-header.qmd >}


::: {#exr-goldfish-win-radio}
Take these facts about the relationship between the blue axes and black grid marks and plug them into a formula. Note that the function in @fig-scaling-2-panels is `hillside()`.

```{r}
modelfun <- function(Qin) {
  5 * hillside((Qin - 100) / 50) + 2
}
```

Using `modelfun()` is effectively using the blue labels for the inputs and outputs. For instance:

```{r}
modelfun(75)
modelfun(125)
```

:::
 <!-- end of exr-goldfish-win-radio -->
